reason: Ten stores for twelve months is almost a million pesos locked in with a company that has zero results. I already paid for a system nobody touched after three months, and I'm not explaining that to the owner a second time.
objection: Nobody has proven it works, and I don't know if using our CCTV for analytics is even clean under the Data Privacy Act. If NPC or a customer complains, I'm the one holding it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or paid-on-results pilot in 2-3 of our stores for 2-3 months with no 12-month lock-in, plus a written Data Privacy Act compliance opinion I can show our DPO.
